name: Invisibility
entries: A creature you touch has the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition until the spell ends. The spell ends early immediately after the target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

omissions.mechanic: ending after the target attacks, deals damage, or casts a spell
omissions.reason: Spell-owned action termination is being added in Wave 1B.
Multi-target spell selection is being added in Wave 1B.
